newsitem.title: CANADA: Moffat to buy Florida cable system.
newsitem.headline: Moffat to buy Florida cable system.

text.p: Moffat Communications Ltd said on Tuesday it signed a definitive agreement to buy the cable television system serving Palm Coast, Florida, for roughly US$29.65 million from Benchmark Communications.
Moffat said it will fund the acquisition through additional bank lines of credit and added that the price is subject to closing adjustments.
The deal is expected to close on March 4, 1997. The terms and conditions are consistent with the letter of intent signed on September 5.
Moffat said Palm Coast is a community in Flagler County on the east coast of Florida about 60 miles south of Jacksonville.
